name: _Handle Auth Close
purpose: Closes the QuickBooks sign-in: stops the timer, gets the auth result (the JWT returned by the sign-in proxy), shows a dialog on an error or a failure, and passes a good result to 'ApiKey Recieved' to store it.
open_question: secret: the result is a JWT / API key held in global variable $$jwt (read at step 32 and passed to script 68 at step 39), the target must keep it out of code and logs. The compare of the returned company id with QBOConfig::CompanyID (step 34) has no action inside the If. The 'ApiKey Recieved' script is outside this share.

name: _Reveal Auth Card
purpose: Starts the QuickBooks sign-in: installs the close handler timer, reads the QBO configuration, builds the proxy URL with the license, company id, sandbox and payments flags, opens the Authorize card and points its web viewer at that URL, then starts the watcher timer.
open_question: secret: the license key and company id go in the URL query string (steps 20, 21) of the sign-in proxy. Step 14 exits with $error, which is never set. Comment '##proxy2 replace' marks it as the replacement for the older flow.

name: _OAuth BaseURL
purpose: Returns the base URL of the LedgerLink sign-in proxy: https://proxy2.ledgerlink.co (a localhost:3050 URL is selected only by a disabled $dev switch). Used by the OAuth, request and refresh scripts.
open_question: The production proxy host is hard-coded (step 4).

name: _Watcher
purpose: Timer that watches the sign-in web viewer: when its page text contains the marker '|---', it cuts the token out between '---|' and '|---', stores it in global variable $$jwt, sends the viewer to a neutral page and closes the card window.
external:
Set Web Viewer step 13
web viewer content read (GetLayoutObjectAttribute of 'wc' content) step 6
open_question: secret: step 11 extracts the JWT / API key from the web page text into $$jwt. Step 16 exits with $result, which is never set. Step 13 sends the web viewer to https://www.geistinteractive.com.

name: _Cancel
purpose: Cancel button of the sign-in card: clears the stored token variable and closes the window.

name: _Get Auth Result
purpose: Returns the stored sign-in token (global variable $$jwt) and clears it.
open_question: secret: returns the JWT held in $$jwt.
